cards.example_en: The clinic offers free medical checks for schoolchildren.
cards.example_zh: 这家诊所为学龄儿童提供免费体检。

cards.example_en: The bitter medicine worked, and her fever fell by evening.
cards.example_zh: 这苦药起了作用，到傍晚她的烧退了。

cards.example_en: I need a medium size, please.
cards.example_zh: 请给我一件中号的。

cards.example_en: We meet our teacher at the museum entrance.
cards.example_zh: 我们在博物馆入口遇见老师。

cards.example_en: The team meeting ended early because the coach was ill.
cards.example_zh: 教练病了，所以队会提前结束了。

cards.example_en: She is a member of the tennis club.
cards.example_zh: 她是网球俱乐部的成员。

cards.example_en: Dad forgot to mention the parent meeting at dinner.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸吃晚饭时忘了提及家长会。

cards.example_en: Nothing on the menu looked familiar except rice and eggs.
cards.example_zh: 菜单上除了米饭和鸡蛋，别的都不眼熟。

cards.example_en: Paint left a mess on the floor of the art room.
cards.example_zh: 颜料把美术教室的地板弄得一片混乱。

cards.example_en: Can I leave a message for Mr Brown?
cards.example_zh: 我可以给Brown先生留言吗？

cards.example_en: Her method is to read the questions before the passage.
cards.example_zh: 她的方法是先读题目，再读文章。

cards.example_en: Stand one metre away from the person in front of you.
cards.example_zh: 和前面的人保持一公尺的距离。

cards.example_en: Our seats were in the middle, close to the aisle.
cards.example_zh: 我们的座位在中间，靠近过道。

cards.example_en: It might rain this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 今天下午可能会下雨。

cards.example_en: The stadium is half a mile from the nearest bus stop.
cards.example_zh: 体育场离最近的公交车站有半英里。

cards.example_en: Hot milk and bread are my usual breakfast on school days.
cards.example_zh: 热牛奶加面包是我上学日通常的早餐。

cards.example_en: The tune stayed in my mind long after the concert ended.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会结束很久了，那首曲子还留在我的头脑里。

cards.example_en: That red umbrella is mine.
cards.example_zh: 那把红伞是我的。

cards.example_en: Give me a minute to tie my shoes before we run.
cards.example_zh: 跑步前给我一分钟，我系一下鞋带。

cards.example_en: He looked in the mirror and smiled.
cards.example_zh: 他照了照镜子，笑了。

cards.example_en: I still miss my primary school friends on weekends.
cards.example_zh: 到了周末，我仍然想念小学的朋友。

word.example_en: Can you take a message for Anna?
word.example_zh: 你能给安娜捎个口信吗？

word.example_en: The table is in the middle of the room.
I may change my mind after lunch.
word.example_zh: 午饭后我可能改变主意。

word.example_en: Keep in mind that the gate closes at six.
I cannot make up my mind about the colour.
word.example_zh: 我还没对颜色下定决心。

word.example_en: She will make up her mind to join the team.
word.example_zh: 她会拿定主意加入队伍。
